Description
Abbey College is a small, friendly, and welcoming boarding school located in the heart of Manchester. A place where teachers and students work to achieve academic success together. Abbey is known for providing innovative and flexible courses which focus on informal and highly personalized learning. Every year our students move on to join some of the UK’s best universities. 52% of A level results in 2020 were A* or A.
